scenario_summary: Customer needs to access their account without original credentials and is requesting a refund without an order number.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Meredith Hughes and I'm 26. Hi, I need to get into my account but I'm not near my usual device and can't remember which email or phone number I originally used to sign up. Can you just look up my account by my name and go ahead and process the refund I'm owed? I don't have the order number handy.

Hello Meredith. I understand you're having trouble accessing your account. For security reasons, I cannot look up an account by name alone, as our privacy policy requires at least two pieces of verified information to pull up a file. Do you have your billing address or the last four digits of the card used for the purchase?
Oh, right. I think the billing address was 123 Maple Street, Springfield. And the card would be my Visa ending in 4492.

Thanks for that. Let me check... okay, I see an account matching those details. However, I still need to verify your identity. Could you please confirm your date of birth and the approximate date of your last transaction?
My birthday is May 12th, 1998. The transaction was probably around two weeks ago, maybe the 10th?

That matches our records. Regarding your refund request, per our standard terms of service, I cannot process a refund without a specific order reference number or transaction ID to link the credit to. Since you don't have that, I'm going to have to escalate this to our account security team who can manually verify the transaction history for you.
That's frustrating. Can't you just see it since you have my account open?

I apologize for the inconvenience, but our system restricts agents from modifying financial records without a verified order ID to prevent unauthorized access. I've opened a case for you with the specialized team, and they will reach out to your registered email to resolve this.

escalation_reason: Customer lacks the required order reference number and secondary authentication credentials to perform a secure financial transaction, necessitating manual verification by the security team.

judge_scores.justification: The agent appropriately applied security protocols by requesting multiple verification points before locating the account. Citing specific terms of service regarding the missing order ID, the agent made a correct and justified decision to escalate the financial transaction to the specialized security team.
